failure: Failure: Does not exclude other Kondo-breakdown or nonperturbative explanations. The J3 counterexample refutes the inference that competition alone forces a soft continuum; it is not an empirically validated replacement model.
interface: Interface: These are scoped calculations for the displayed scalar exchange, smooth-band and force-balance models. The J1–J2 lattice is a trial model rather than an established microscopic model of Ce3Pd20Si6; the actual band, internal multipolar structure, electron-coupled operator, vertex, incommensurability and momentum sink remain unresolved.

claims.title: The proposed J1–J2 strange-metal soft-mode explanation fails its current-weight and lattice tests
